key.name: gap
key.summary: Gap left around a window maximized via any native path
key.description: Pixel gap kept around a window's edges when it is maximized through the titlebar button, double-click-titlebar, a keybinding or the window menu. The window is immediately unmaximized and resized to the work area minus this gap, so it never enters Mutter's true maximized state and keeps rounded corners, matching the look of dragging a window to the screen's top edge under Tiling Shell.
